standard.summary: 每隔多少个优化步更新一次 EMA 副本。默认 1 = 每步更新。
standard.effect: 增大该值可略微降低 EMA 的计算开销，但平滑效果会变粗糙（相当于 decay 等效窗口缩短）。
standard.whenToUse: 通常保持默认 1。仅在训练速度瓶颈明确来自 EMA 更新时才考虑增大。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设置过大（如 >10），否则 EMA 权重可能在步间剧烈跳动。

standard_en.summary: How many optimizer steps pass between EMA updates. The default of 1 updates every step.
standard_en.effect: Raising it shaves a little off the EMA's cost but coarsens the smoothing (equivalent to shortening the decay window).
standard_en.whenToUse: Normally leave it at 1. Consider raising it only when the EMA update is demonstrably the speed bottleneck.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not recommended too high (>10), or the EMA weights may jump sharply between steps.

advanced.principle: 每 N 步才执行一次 θ_ema = decay × θ_ema + (1-decay) × θ_t，其余步 EMA 权重不变。
advanced.intervention: 减少 EMA copy 操作次数，对大模型可降低同步开销。
advanced.expectedImpact: N=1 最精确；N>1 节省约 N-1 次 tensor copy，但平滑窗口等效变短。
advanced.tradeoffs: EMA 更新本身开销很小（仅 tensor 加权），通常不是瓶颈，一般不需要调整。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/training_loop.py → EMA update 条件判断

advanced_en.principle: Only every N steps executes θ_ema = decay × θ_ema + (1-decay) × θ_t; EMA weights stay unchanged on other steps.
advanced_en.intervention: Reduces EMA copy operations, lowering sync overhead for large models.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: N=1 is most accurate; N>1 saves N-1 tensor copies but effectively shortens the smoothing window.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The EMA update itself is cheap (just tensor averaging) and rarely the bottleneck — usually no need to adjust.
